responsibility: Declares region_model_manager, the analyzer’s owning and consolidating factory for immutable region and svalue objects. It exposes creation and uniquing APIs for constants, unknowns, pointer and operator svalues, conjured and asm-derived values, call strings, all region kinds, store/range managers, known-function registration, and dynamic heap/alloca regions, along with complexity checks and logging hooks used by the engine and region_model.
same_name_distinction: Declares region_model_manager’s owning/uniquing API for call strings, svalues, regions, stores, ranges, dynamic allocations, and known-function access; unlike region-model-manager.cc, it presents the factory interface and stored managers rather than the consolidation mechanics.
